findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a new client closes a fix for an unsigned working prototype.
The Done-when line is: "Forge's own repo and new client repos run the Codex code review and the Codex cold read on gpt-6.1-terra at max effort; existing client repos keep their forge.toml". Init pins the normal review to max but writes no light-review entry. For a working prototype, `src/forge/review.py:852-853` selects the light path, and `src/forge/review.py:953-960` replaces the effort with medium when that entry is absent. These reviews therefore run Terra at medium, not max.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - the pull-request test check runs the affected tests.
The changed `GRILL` fixture is imported by `tests/test_tools_native_reads.py:53-78` and `tests/test_readloop_rounds.py:402,520,565`, which still expect Sol and high effort; their Codex cases now fail. Separately, the new review pin in `src/forge/init.py:128` makes the generated Codex diagnostic roles use Terra/max, while `tests/test_claude_subagent_defaults.py:83-87` still expects no pin, breaking the full suite. The fixture change also makes the model-change case in `tests/test_worker_and_reader_chats_survive_rounds.py:250-254` leave the Codex settings unchanged, silently losing that coverage.

findings.body:

Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - the pull-request test check validates the shipped guide.
The added lines increase the Tools section from 40 to 42 lines. `tests/test_tools_guide.py:36-38` requires at most 40, and `.forge/always-tests.txt:2` includes that test in the check. The required test check will fail until the section is shortened or the new text is moved.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a new client performs a Codex cold read or Forge reviews its own change.
The named reader proof overwrites a separate Forge-source checkout with a hand-written `GRILL` table at `tests/test_codex_reader.py:53-54`; it only parses the newly initialized client's settings later at lines 173-175. The own-repo proof in `tests/test_fix_the_owner_moved_this_repo_s_workers_from.py:45-74` parses Forge's settings and runs `forge work`, not a review. A client-specific read routing failure or Forge-source-specific review routing failure could therefore pass the listed proofs. Exercise those commands with the settings each repo actually receives.
